name: nws_connect
title: NWS Connect Service Profile
description: OGC API - EDR Part 3 Service Profile for NWS Connect: real-time GeoJSON notification messages for water gauge observations, NWS Weather Watches, Warnings and Advisories, and NOAA SWPC space weather alerts, delivered over EDR Part 2 PubSub (native WebSocket, AMQP 1.0, and MQTT) alongside the standard EDR Part 1 Features endpoints.

contact.instructions: Data provided by the National Weather Service.

collections.title: Water Gauge Data
collections.description: Real-time GeoJSON notification messages for water gauge observations including flood stage information

flood_stage.description: Flood stage classification (major, moderate, minor, action, below_action, unknown)

feet_above_stage.description: Feet of observation above the observed flood stage

collections.title: Weather Watches and Warnings
collections.description: NWS Weather Watches and Warnings from CAP (Common Alerting Protocol) alerts

CAP_info_event.description: Event type (e.g., Tornado Warning, Flood Watch)

CAP_info_severity.description: Severity level (Extreme, Severe, Moderate, Minor, Unknown)

CAP_info_urgency.description: Urgency level (Immediate, Expected, Future, Past, Unknown)

CAP_status.description: Alert status (Actual, Exercise, System, Test, Draft)

collections.title: NOAA SWPC Space Weather Alerts
collections.description: Alerts, warnings, watches, and summaries from the NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center (SWPC). Includes geomagnetic storms (G-scale), solar radiation storms (S-scale), and radio blackouts (R-scale).

message_type.description: Type of space weather message (Alert, Warning, Watch, Summary)

noaa_scale.description: NOAA Space Weather Scale designation (G1-G5, S1-S5, R1-R5)

scale_category.description: Scale category letter (G=Geomagnetic, S=Solar Radiation, R=Radio Blackout)

collections.title: NWS County Warning Areas
collections.description: Geographic boundaries of NWS County Warning Areas (CWA) in WKT format - NWS - CWA - boundaries - geographic

collections.title: States
collections.description: Geographic boundaries of states within the United States

requirements.statement: The service SHALL declare conformance to OGC API - EDR Part 1 Core and Part 2 PubSub.
parts: The service SHALL provide a /conformance endpoint.
The response SHALL include http://www.opengis.net/spec/ogcapi-edr-1/1.0/conf/core.
The response SHALL include http://www.opengis.net/spec/ogcapi-edr-2/1.0/conf/pubsub.

requirements.statement: The service SHALL provide a /collections endpoint listing all collections.
parts: The service SHALL provide a /collections endpoint.
The response SHALL include water_gauge, wwa, space_weather, cwa, and states collections.
Each collection SHALL have id, title, description, extent, and links properties.

requirements.statement: The water_gauge collection SHALL provide GeoJSON features with flood stage information.
parts: The service SHALL provide a /collections/water_gauge endpoint.
The service SHALL provide a /collections/water_gauge/items endpoint.
The response Content-Type SHALL be application/geo+json.
Each feature SHALL include flood_stage, feet_above_stage, and value properties.
Each feature geometry SHALL be a GeoJSON Point.

requirements.statement: The wwa collection SHALL provide GeoJSON features for weather watches and warnings.
parts: The service SHALL provide a /collections/wwa endpoint.
The service SHALL provide a /collections/wwa/items endpoint.
The response Content-Type SHALL be application/geo+json.
Each feature SHALL include CAP_info_event, CAP_info_severity, CAP_info_urgency, and CAP_status properties.
Each feature geometry SHALL be a GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon.

requirements.statement: The space_weather collection SHALL provide GeoJSON features for NOAA SWPC space weather alerts.
parts: The service SHALL provide a /collections/space_weather endpoint.
The service SHALL provide a /collections/space_weather/items endpoint.
The response Content-Type SHALL be application/geo+json.
Each feature SHALL include message_type, noaa_scale, scale_category, and scale_level properties.

requirements.statement: The cwa collection SHALL provide GeoJSON features for NWS County Warning Areas.
parts: The service SHALL provide a /collections/cwa endpoint.
The service SHALL provide a /collections/cwa/items endpoint.
The response Content-Type SHALL be application/geo+json.
Each feature SHALL include a CWA identifier property.
Each feature geometry SHALL be a GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon.

requirements.statement: The states collection SHALL provide GeoJSON features for US state boundaries.
parts: The service SHALL provide a /collections/states endpoint.
The service SHALL provide a /collections/states/items endpoint.
The response Content-Type SHALL be application/geo+json.
Each feature SHALL include a state identifier property.
Each feature geometry SHALL be a GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon.

requirements.statement: All collections SHALL support retrieval of individual features by ID.
parts: Each collection SHALL provide a /collections/{collectionId}/items/{featureId} endpoint.
The response SHALL return a single GeoJSON feature.
The response SHALL return 404 if the feature does not exist.

requirements.statement: The service SHALL support AMQP 1.0 and MQTT pub/sub for real-time notifications on water_gauge, wwa, and space_weather collections.
parts: The service SHALL provide an AMQP 1.0 broker (edr-broker) on port 5672 (RabbitMQ 4.x native AMQP 1.0).
The service SHALL provide an MQTT broker (edr-broker) on port 1883 over the same amq.topic exchange.
Clients SHALL be able to consume from a queue bound to amq.topic with binding key collections.water_gauge.items.
Clients SHALL be able to consume from a queue bound to amq.topic with binding key collections.wwa.items.
Clients SHALL be able to consume from a queue bound to amq.topic with binding key collections.space_weather.items.
Clients SHALL authenticate with SASL PLAIN using their account email as the username and a named WebSocket key (wsk_...) as the password.
Notifications SHALL be published as GeoJSON features.

requirements.statement: The service SHALL support a native WebSocket pub/sub endpoint for browser clients.
parts: The service SHALL provide a WebSocket endpoint at /ws for local development (ws) and production (wss).
The WebSocket endpoint SHALL deliver the same GeoJSON feature notifications as the AMQP 1.0 and MQTT transports.
WebSocket connections SHALL authenticate with the same identity used for the AMQP/MQTT transports.

requirements.statement: The water_gauge collection pub/sub SHALL support filtering by flood stages, stations, and WFO.
parts: Subscriptions SHALL accept flood_stages filter (array of stage values).
Subscriptions SHALL accept stations filter (comma-separated station IDs or 'all').
Subscriptions SHALL accept wfo filter (Weather Forecast Office codes).
Subscriptions SHALL accept email filter for notification delivery.

requirements.statement: The wwa collection pub/sub SHALL support filtering by event types, state, and CWA.
parts: Subscriptions SHALL accept event_types filter (array of weather event types).
Subscriptions SHALL accept state filter (state code or blank for all).
Subscriptions SHALL accept cwa filter (County Warning Area code).
Subscriptions SHALL accept email filter for notification delivery.

requirements.statement: The space_weather collection pub/sub SHALL support filtering by message type and NOAA scale.
parts: Subscriptions SHALL accept message_type filter (Alert, Warning, Watch, Summary).
Subscriptions SHALL accept scale_category filter (G, S, R).
Subscriptions SHALL accept scale_level filter (minimum NOAA scale level 1-5).
Subscriptions SHALL accept email filter for notification delivery.

steps: Send GET request to /conformance.
Verify response contains http://www.opengis.net/spec/ogcapi-edr-1/1.0/conf/core.
Verify response contains http://www.opengis.net/spec/ogcapi-edr-2/1.0/conf/pubsub.
Send GET request to /collections.
Verify response contains collections array.
Verify water_gauge, wwa, space_weather, cwa, and states are present in the collections array.
Verify each collection has id, title, description, extent, and links.
Send GET request to /collections/water_gauge.
Verify response contains collection metadata.
Send GET request to /collections/water_gauge/items?limit=10.
Verify response Content-Type is application/geo+json.
Verify each feature contains flood_stage, feet_above_stage, and value properties.
Verify each feature geometry type is Point.
Send GET request to /collections/wwa.
Verify response contains collection metadata.
Send GET request to /collections/wwa/items?limit=10.
Verify response Content-Type is application/geo+json.
Verify each feature contains CAP_info_event, CAP_info_severity, CAP_info_urgency, and CAP_status properties.
Verify each feature geometry type is Polygon or MultiPolygon.
Send GET request to /collections/space_weather.
Verify response contains collection metadata.
Send GET request to /collections/space_weather/items?limit=10.
Verify response Content-Type is application/geo+json.
Verify each feature contains message_type, noaa_scale, scale_category, and scale_level properties.
Send GET request to /collections/cwa.
Verify response contains collection metadata.
Send GET request to /collections/cwa/items?limit=10.
Verify response Content-Type is application/geo+json.
Verify each feature contains a CWA identifier.
Verify each feature geometry type is Polygon or MultiPolygon.
Send GET request to /collections/states.
Verify response contains collection metadata.
Send GET request to /collections/states/items?limit=10.
Verify response Content-Type is application/geo+json.
Verify each feature contains a state identifier.
Verify each feature geometry type is Polygon or MultiPolygon.
Send GET request to /collections/water_gauge/items?limit=1.
Extract the id of the first feature.
Send GET request to /collections/water_gauge/items/{featureId}.
Verify response is a single GeoJSON feature with matching id.
Send GET request to /collections/water_gauge/items/nonexistent.
Verify response status is 404.
Connect to the AMQP 1.0 broker (edr-broker) on port 5672 using SASL PLAIN (email + wsk_ key).
Declare a queue and bind it to the amq.topic exchange with binding key collections.water_gauge.items.
Verify notifications are received as GeoJSON features.
Bind a queue to amq.topic with binding key collections.wwa.items.
Verify notifications are received as GeoJSON features.
Connect to the MQTT broker (edr-broker) on port 1883 and subscribe to topic collections/+/items.
Verify notifications are received as GeoJSON features.
Connect to the native WebSocket endpoint at /ws (ws locally, wss in production).
Verify the connection succeeds and delivers GeoJSON feature notifications.
Verify notifications match those delivered over the AMQP 1.0 and MQTT transports.
Subscribe to collections/water_gauge/items/# with flood_stages filter set to ["major", "moderate"].
Verify only notifications matching the specified flood stages are received.
Subscribe with stations filter set to specific station IDs.
Verify only notifications for those stations are received.
Subscribe with wfo filter set to a specific office code.
Verify only notifications for that WFO are received.
Subscribe to collections/wwa/items/# with event_types filter set to ["Tornado Warning"].
Verify only notifications matching the specified event types are received.
Subscribe with state filter set to a specific state code.
Verify only notifications for that state are received.
Subscribe with cwa filter set to a specific CWA code.
Verify only notifications for that CWA are received.
Subscribe to collections/space_weather/items/# with message_type filter set to "Warning".
Verify only notifications matching the specified message type are received.
Subscribe with scale_category filter set to "G".
Verify only geomagnetic-storm notifications are received.
Subscribe with scale_level filter set to 3.
Verify only notifications at or above NOAA scale level 3 are received.

servers.name: amqp
servers.description: AMQP 1.0 broker (edr-broker, RabbitMQ 4.x native AMQP 1.0). Consume from a queue bound to the amq.topic exchange with binding key collections.*.items (v2 source address /queues/<your-queue>; declare and bind it first). Authenticate with SASL PLAIN: your account email as the username and a named WebSocket key (POST /api/ws-keys, value starts with wsk_) as the password. Read-only; fire-and-forget (re-hydrate current state from /collections/{id}/items on reconnect).

servers.name: mqtt
servers.description: MQTT broker (edr-broker, RabbitMQ MQTT plugin over the same amq.topic exchange). Subscribe to topic collections/+/items (or a specific collections/<id>/items). Authenticate with your account email as the username and a named WebSocket key (wsk_...) as the password. Read-only; fire-and-forget.

filters.name: flood_stages
filters.description: Alert for selected flood stages (below_action, action, minor, moderate, major)

filters.name: stations
filters.description: Comma-separated station IDs or 'all' for all stations

filters.name: wfo
filters.description: Weather Forecast Office codes (e.g., PHI, AKQ, OKX)

filters.name: event_types
filters.description: Weather event types to subscribe to (e.g., Tornado Warning, Flood Watch)

filters.name: state
filters.description: Filter by state, or leave blank for all states

filters.name: cwa
filters.description: Filter by County Warning Area code

filters.name: message_type
filters.description: Filter by message type (Alert, Warning, Watch, Summary)

filters.name: scale_category
filters.description: Filter by NOAA scale category (G, S, R)

filters.name: scale_level
filters.description: Filter by minimum NOAA scale level (1-5)
